requirement.fact: {efficiency_emilia} noted that the risk assessment is currently done by hand.
requirement.reading: She would accept a manual risk assessment if it allows for deeper strategic review.

speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: You are treating my manual risk assessment as a gap to be closed, but it is a deliberate control for strategic review. Do not strip that layer out without acknowledging the tradeoff you are making to your timeline.
output.correction: I did not say the manual process is broken or that we need to automate it to save time. I said I accept the manual step because it forces the deeper strategic review that your automated tools currently miss.
